pages.content:
# Example Ledger

Example Ledger is bookkeeping software for independent cafes and bakeries.

## How does Example Ledger work?
Connect your till and bank feed; we categorise every sale and supplier invoice.

## Who is it for?
Owner-run cafes and bakeries with one to five sites.

# Example Ledger

> Bookkeeping software for independent cafes and bakeries.

- [FAQ](https://example.com/faq): answers to common setup and pricing questions
- [About](https://example.com/about): who we are and who we serve

pages.title: FAQ — Example Ledger
pages.content:
## Does it work with my till?
Yes, with the five most common cafe tills.
## How much does it cost?
From 29 a month per site.
## Can my accountant log in?
Yes.
## Is my data backed up?
Daily.
## Can I import last year's books?
Yes, from a spreadsheet.
## Do you support VAT returns?
Yes.
## Is there a contract?
No, monthly.
## Can I add a second site?
Yes.
## Where is support?
Email, weekdays.
